description:
Hyunsoo, set to graduate from art school, misses his final nude croquis exam. As a result, his professor, Yujin Song, gives him an F. Desperate, Hyunsoo pleads with Professor Song, who finally allows him to retake the test alone. And the model is Professor Song herself.
